 About The Role
 In this role, you will build the Angular frontends of MCCS Forecasting & Planning, a modular platform that brings load, renewable, and generation forecasts together with outage and power plant schedules into one single source of truth for control centers. You will also own automated testing, from component level up to end-to-end, so that every release is dependable for the people running the grid.
 Responsibilities
Develop Angular frontends for the forecasting and planning platform, creating reusable UI components and modular web applications
Own test automation across unit, component, integration, and end-to-end levels with Playwright, Cypress, or similar tools, so that regressions are caught before release
Work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and QA engineers to write testable acceptance criteria
Integrate the frontends with backend services through APIs, keeping data in control-center views accurate and consistent
Design test cases using risk-based, regression, and exploratory testing, and analyze defects to find root causes
Maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated tests in Azure Pipelines, and document test plans in Azure Test Plans
Review code in Git and share frontend and testing practices within the team
Apply security, data protection, and web accessibility principles to every feature
 Requirements
3+ years of software development with a focus on web frontends
Solid knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with hands-on experience in a modern framework, preferably Angular
Experience building reusable UI components, modular web applications, and API integrations
Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated tests (unit, component, integration, end-to-end) with Playwright, Cypress, or similar
Knowledge of test methodology: test case design, risk-based, regression, and exploratory testing, and defect analysis
Practical experience with Git, code reviews, and CI/CD, including automated tests in Azure Pipelines and documentation in Azure Test Plans
Working knowledge of DevOps, security, data protection, and web accessibility basics
Good English to work with the client, join technical discussions, and write documentation. German as a plus
Quality-focused mindset and a collaborative way of working with product, business, and QA colleagues
